header: What happens to the data you leave in the portal
intro: This notice covers meridiangroup.at, the customer portal and the Meridian Service app. It is written for buyers, design engineers and applicants, and it names the systems the data actually sits in rather than describing them in the abstract.

sections.title: What we store when you request a quote
sections.content: Company name, contact name, work email, phone number and any drawing you upload. The drawing is held in the quotation system in Graz and deleted 24 months after the quotation lapses, unless it turns into an order.

sections.title: Who inside Meridian can see it
sections.content: Sales engineers of the division you addressed, the calculation desk, and quality staff once an order exists. Brno and Turin see an enquiry only when the part is to be produced there. Nobody outside the group is given access.

sections.title: How to object, correct or delete
sections.content: Write to the data protection officer in Graz. Corrections are made within five working days and deletions within 30 days, except for records Austrian commercial law requires us to keep for seven years.
